narrative: Today's briefing highlights critical discussions on the future of email, advancements in biological reprogramming for aging, and the implications of AI on privacy and security. Geopolitical tensions regarding digital sovereignty and new threats to software supply chains emphasize the evolving challenges in the tech landscape. Scientific exploration continues with insights into human senses and unidentified space phenomena.
